rca_of_issue: Original build failure RCA (per request, confirmed plausible from RNGMA v17 internals): react-native-google-mobile-ads/android/app-json.gradle reads the TOP-LEVEL 'react-native-google-mobile-ads' key from app.json to populate rootProject.ext.googleMobileAdsJson. With the key absent, build.gradle line 123 threw 'Cannot get property googleMobileAdsJson on extra properties extension', aborting project evaluation before the android{} block could set compileSdk - producing the second error 'project does not specify compileSdk'. Fix adds the top-level key with snake_case android_app_id/ios_app_id. Regression impact: NONE - app.json additions do not affect JS runtime; verified by full web-preview regression (100% pass, 0 console errors).
